usage.minimumClearSpace: Keep at least the visual width of the orange window clear around the complete logo.
usage.lightSurface: Use the primary black and orange logo.
usage.darkSurface: Use the inverse white and orange logo.
prohibited: Do not stretch, rotate, crop, outline, recolor, or add effects to the logo.
Do not place the logo over a busy image without a quiet, high-contrast field.
Do not publish unverified property facts, rankings, ratings, guarantees, or leadership identities.
